title: Mapping Sets
$comment: Data type mapping sets, one file each under `data_types/mapping_sets/`. A set pairs each application type — the physical view of a signal, with its unit, its conversion and its range — with the implementation type that stores it, and a component names the sets its behaviour maps with. Every application type or enumeration a component's ports speak in has to be paired in one of them, because generated code needs to know what stores it. The directory is mandatory and may be empty: a project whose interfaces are typed by implementation types alone needs no set.

name.description: The set's identity; the file is named from it (`data_types/mapping_sets/{name}.yaml`, or a suffixed name when another file collides case-insensitively) and is never what identifies it. Unique across the layer, must not be blank, and immutable.

maps.description: The pairs the set declares, addressed by the application type each one maps, which appears at most once in a set. The order is the model's and is the order the pairs are emitted in. An empty list is legal and declares nothing.

description.description: Free text about the set. Written into the generated ARXML as the element's `DESC`, exactly as held; the empty default writes none.

package.description: The one sub-package of `/DataTypes/MappingSets`, its layer's package, this mapping set is emitted in, a single SHORT-NAME segment: the mapping set and every reference to it take `/DataTypes/MappingSets/{package}/`. Absent means `/DataTypes/MappingSets` itself. SWCraft's importers record it for an element whose source path is exactly `/DataTypes/MappingSets/{package}/{name}`, SWCraft's own layout, so a project's export imports back placed; and for an element that would otherwise share `/DataTypes/MappingSets` with a name differing from its own only in case. An author may set it to place an element or to resolve such a collision. It is held to the AUTOSAR Identifier rule.

map.description: One pair: the application type, and the implementation type that stores it. Both sides name a declared data type by its own name; which kinds each side may name is checked across files, because the answer is in the type's own file and not here.

application.description: The name of the declared application type, enumeration, record or array this pair maps, an element of the `application_types` layer. It is the pair's identity inside the set, and so immutable.

implementation.description: The name of the declared value type, reference type, implementation record or implementation array that stores it, and never a pointer. Repointing the pair at another implementation type edits this field; pairing a different application type is a different pair.
